text.en:
Funding. Funds needed to carry out the
provisions of this Executive Order shall be taken out of the
appropriations of the
Council in the current
Appropriations Act.
Implementing Rules.
The Council shall issue
rules, regulations and issuances as may be necessary to ensure
effective implementation of the provisions of this
Repealing Clause.
All laws, ordinances, rules
and regulations, other issuances or parts thereof, which are
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.
effect immediately.
Effectivity.
This Executive Order shall take
APPROVED in the city of Manila, Philippines, this 22nd day
in the Year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and
Eighty-Seven.
By the President:
72
Executive Secretary
